cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 says a law, decree or policy in force classifies government data or requires state data to be held in the country; the Data Protection Act's local-copy rule covers personal data in general.
cells.note: Reassessed under Bill's ruling of 2026-10-31 (messages-for-bill 60: a rule must include government or state data): the Data Protection Act's local-copy rule binds personal data held by any controller, not state data (BWA-001), so it no longer answers question 2. The government's decision to move its systems to the Delta data centre is a stated goal (BWA-002, BWA-004), so stage 2.
